reviews.text: The mini size is great for on the go traveling and it’s still protective product itself and applies beautifully
reviews.zh: 迷你裝出門旅行一流，產品本身仲有保護效果，而且上妝都好靚。

reviews.text: I ordered the mini my mistake! Thought it was regular size hahaha. So make sure to check! The foundation itself is long lasting and the color doesn’t fade much. I have oily skin so this matte cushion is perfect. There is a pleasant rosy scent in the foundation too.
reviews.zh: 我落錯單買咗迷你裝！以為係正常裝 hahaha。所以記得睇清楚！粉底本身好持久，顏色都唔太褪。我係油性肌，所以呢款霧面氣墊啱晒。粉底仲有陣好聞嘅玫瑰香味。

reviews.text: This is a great product. The foundation is thin and light, and sticks to the skin for a long time without smudging, cracking, or becoming powdery. I will definitely recommend this product from now on. Be sure to try it out, everyone
reviews.zh: 呢款產品好正。粉底薄又輕，貼住皮膚好耐都唔會甩妝、爆裂或者出現粉感。我由依家開始一定會推薦呢款產品。大家一定要試下。

reviews.text:
DEBAH! Wow! This is the most covering, moisturizing, magical makeup I’ve ever worn! 
First time ever trying this brand and I don’t plan on using anything else after finding this! I just can’t!
reviews.zh:
DEBAH！嘩！呢個係我戴過最遮瑕、最保濕、最神奇嘅化妝品！
第一次試呢個品牌，搵到呢款之後我唔打算再用其他嘢！我真係停唔到！

reviews.text: Possibly my new favourite foundation, and in a mini compact which is great for travel! The "thin tech" really shows with this; it's light, not cakey, with nice buildable coverage. It doesn't dry my skin out either. Doesn't oxidise like the Red cushion does. Wish it had a refil option though.
reviews.zh: 可能係我嘅新寵粉底，仲要係迷你裝，旅行一流！「thin tech」真係喺呢度表露無遺——輕盈、唔厚重，遮瑕度可以一層層疊上去。亦都唔會令皮膚變乾。冇好似 Red cushion 嗰款咁氧化變色。不過就希望有替換裝選擇。

reviews.text: I got the red cushion and loved it. I got this AI orange mini for my sister and she also loves it. The red one has more of a skin-like appeal and of course this AI cushion has more of a blurring affect. My sister has went and rebought this cushion in the bigger size bc she likes it so much. She said it applies super well over skincare, doesn't dry out her skin or break her out, and overall looks really nice.
reviews.zh: 我買咗紅色嗰款，超鍾意。之後買咗呢款 AI 橙色迷你裝畀我妹，佢都好鍾意。紅色嗰款望落比較貼近自己膚質，而呢款 AI 氣墊當然就有比較強嘅磨皮效果。我妹之後去回購咗大裝嘅呢款氣墊，因為佢真係好鍾意。佢話搽喺護膚品上面好貼，唔會令皮膚變乾或者爆瘡，整體望落好好睇。

reviews.text: It’s so hard to find the appropriate shade since people generally recommend to order 2-3 shades below your typical korean foundation shade. After much consideration I chose 17C (usually 21N with neutral-cool undertones). In the photo it looks super peachy/orange compared to my typical shade, but when I put them on my face (R/L each) I can’t tell the difference.
reviews.zh: 要搵到啱嘅色號真係好難，因為一般人建議要揀低你平時用嘅韓國粉底色號 2 至 3 度。諗咗好耐我揀咗 17C（平時用 21N 底調係中性偏冷）。相入面望落比起我平時嘅色號超級偏粉橙，但我真係搽上面（左邊右邊一邊一款）係完全睇唔出分別。

reviews.text: I’ve been using the TIRTIR Mask Fit AI Filter Mini Cushion for a couple of weeks now, and I’m honestly impressed. It gives a really natural, soft matte finish that smooths out my skin without feeling heavy or cakey. The coverage is buildable—light at first, but easy to layer where I need more. I love how compact it is too; super convenient for tossing in my bag for touch-ups. It lasts pretty well throughout the day, even in warmer weather. One thing I did notice is that it can oxidize a little, so going one shade lighter might be a good idea. Also, if my skin isn’t well-moisturized, it does cling to dry patches a bit. Overall though, it’s a great everyday cushion, especially if you’re after something that feels light but still evens everything out.
reviews.zh: 我用咗 TIRTIR Mask Fit AI Filter Mini Cushion 幾個星期，老實講好驚喜。佢做到好自然嘅柔霧面妝效，撫平皮膚之餘又唔覺厚重或者有粉感。遮瑕度可以一層層疊加——一開始好薄，但需要嘅地方好易再加上去。佢好細盒我亦都好鍾意；擺入袋補妝超方便。日間持久度都幾好，熱啲嘅天氣都仲得。一樣我留意到嘅係佢會輕微氧化，所以揀淺一個色號可能會好啲。同埋如果皮膚保濕做得唔夠，佢會有少少痴住乾燥位。整體嚟講，呢款係一款好正嘅日常氣墊，特別係你想要輕身但又可以均勻膚色嘅效果。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
